what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1988?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 2010 report (calendar wages) and FY2011-FY2025 (fiscal). The 1988 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (84 pages) was searched for wage, gross, payroll, earnings and salary and returned only the appropriation lines for officers' salaries (p34, p36, p50), the Article 8 motion `to fix the salaries and compensation of all elected officers` (p50), the balance sheet's ACCRUED WAGES PAYABLE $114,596 (p39), and a ballot question on wages (p68) -- no list by employee (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1988 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates for fiscal 1989?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1988 annual town report records the vote but not the schedule: Article 3 of the May 14, 1988 Annual Town Meeting replaced the `Classification and Salary Schedule voted on May 9, 1987` with the one `proposed by the Personnel Committee and appearing in` the Finance Committee's report (p49), and p54 amends sections of the `Salary Administration Plan` in prose. The text was searched for salary schedule, classification, step and grade and found nothing else (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Finance Committee's report to the May 14, 1988 Annual Town Meeting, which printed the Classification & Salary Schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in fiscal 1988?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1988 annual town report prints no separate special revenue schedule: the balance sheet's SPECIAL REVENUE column carries $181,912 of cash (p39), and revolving and grant accounts (School Lunch, P.L. 874, P.L. 94-142, School Athletic, Driver Education, Park Dept. User Fees, Library Gifts) are printed as lines INSIDE the general fund appropriations schedule (p36-p37), where a `rct` mark is a receipt and `fwd` a carry-forward. The text was searched for special revenue and revolving and returned only those lines (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1988 special revenue fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in fiscal 1988?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1988 annual town report prints none: its balance sheet has a CAPITAL PROJECTS column with $78,528 of cash, all designated (p39), and capital articles sit INSIDE the general fund schedule instead (e.g. `Repair School Roof/Windows` $179,283.30 forward, p37; `Highway Bond Issue` $63,632 forward, p36). Searched for capital project and capital fund (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Town Accountant's fiscal 1988 capital projects fund ledger.

what: What did each item of Lunenburg's fiscal 1989 capital plan cost?
why: `capital-plans` holds item-by-item costs. The 1988 annual town report prints no capital plan: Article 69's by-law (p63) would require a capital improvement and replacement program in future, with no amounts. Searched for capital plan and capital improvement across the whole text (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Finance Committee's fiscal 1989 report listing capital articles.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for fiscal 1988?
why: `report-valuation` holds the Assessors' tables (assessments by class, valuation and tax history, overlay, new growth) from the 2001 and 2010 reports and FY2011 onward. The 1988 annual town report prints none of them: the Assessors' report is prose and a list of exemption clauses (p11-p12), the only valuation figures are in ABOUT THE TOWN, `$278,701,700-Real Estate`, `$7,402,600-Personal Prop.`, `TAX RATE: $18.23` (p5) -- and the Treasurer's levy chart (p30, landed as `tax-levy-history`) gives the levy but no valuation by class. The overlay appears only as `$131,990 BE TRANSFERRED FROM THE OVERLAY SURPLUS ACCOUNT` (p50). Searched for valuation, overlay, tax rate, new growth, levy and assessment (sources/data/report-tables/1988/). — closes: the Assessors' fiscal 1988 tax rate recapitulation filed with the Department of Revenue.
